headlines.title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures rise as Nvidia stock recovers, 10-year yield nears 5%
headlines.summary: Nvidia and other chip stocks crept higher, investors shifted their bets on a Fed rate hike next month, and cryptocurrencies fell.

headlines.title: Quake AI Plans to Deploy NVIDIA Minerva to Strengthen AI Factory Operations
headlines.summary: ~RUM Group’s AI infrastructure business, Quake AI, named in NVIDIA’s announcement of Minerva, a new platform designed to support AI factory uptime and performance~ LONGBOAT KEY, Fla., Nov. 11, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Quake AI, the AI infrastructure business of RUM Group Inc. (Nasdaq: RUM), today announced plans to deploy NVIDIA Minerva, a new AI operations platform designed to help operators identify infrastructure issues earlier and keep AI factories productive.

headlines.title: Nvidia stock gets a rare Wall Street downgrade on supply issues
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Baird downgraded Nvidia stock to Neutral and more than halved its price target to $200 from $500, saying a lack of visibility into 2027 data center demand, mostly tied to supply constraints, and uncertainty over U.S. government action and the CEO’s tenure will keep the stock range-bound.

headlines.title: Is the AI Trade Broken, or Did Hedge Funds Just Get Squeezed?
headlines.summary: A Bloomberg veteran who has covered hedge funds for 16 years says he never saw a day like last week, and Nvidia sits at the center of the wreckage. Two competing explanations now collide, and one upcoming report may settle it.

headlines.title: Nvidia faces $7.5 billion chip scandal after $430 billion wipeout
headlines.summary: Nvidia lost approximately $430 billion in market value over two trading sessions, with shares falling 9.5%.

description: NVIDIA Corporation operates as a data center scale AI infrastructure company in the United States, Taiwan, China, Hong Kong, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Compute & Networking, and Graphics segments. The Compute & Networking segment provides data center accelerated computing and networking platforms and artificial intelligence solutions and software, and automotive platforms and autonomous and electric vehicle solutions, including software. The Graphics segment offers GeForce GPUs for gaming and PCs; Quadro/NVIDIA RTX GPUs for enterprise workstation graphics. The company's products are used in gaming, professional visualization, data center, and automotive markets. It sells its products to original equipment manufacturers, original device manufacturers, system integrators and distributors, independent software vendors, cloud service providers, add-in board manufacturers, distributors, automotive manufacturers and tier-1 automotive suppliers, and other ecosystem participants. It has a collaboration with Cisco to develop Ultra-Dense Small Form Factor Pluggable (USFP), a high-density optical module pluggable transceiver. It has a collaboration with ChipAgents to develop Build-A-Chip-Bench, a benchmark for AI agents carrying chip design tasks and The Company has a strategic alliance with MediaTek to build the next generations of AI computing platforms. NVIDIA Corporation was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, California.
